    missing = {"row" => 1, "status" => "missing_path_chunk", "type" => nil, "body" => nil}

    check(c["row_bodies"] == witnesses, "literal populated/missing/empty rows")
    expected_schedule = [0, 1].flat_map do |bucket|
      [[0, 0, 0, 2], [0, 1, 1, 2], [1, 0, 2, 1]].map do |parent, chunk, start, parent_rows|

         "chunk_index" => chunk, "row_start" => start, "row_count" => 1,

    records = c.fetch("path_records")

      child = populated ? "01000000000000000703000000000000006f6e65" : "0000000000000000"

      start = prefix_bytes + 11
      offsets = populated ? [0, prefix_bytes, prefix_bytes + 8, start, start + 8, start + 9, start + 17, start + 20, start + 20] :

      check(record["bucket_index"] == 1 && record["parent_index"] == index && record["chunk_index"] == 0 && record["row_count"] == 1 && record["path"] == "n", "path placement")

      check(record["rows"] == [witnesses[index * 2]], "selected literal witness")
      check(record["roundtrip_data_equal"] == true && record["roundtrip_events_equal"] == true, "helper roundtrip observation")
